features.quote: The tomb of Sheikh Mansur crowns the northern side of the mound
At the eastern foot the opening into the Iron Age water tunnel

date.basis: entry calls it the Iron Age water tunnel

notes: f2: built sheikh's tomb on the mound's northern side, coded N from the site; not described as shaft or rock-cut, so cavity_with_opening false. f3: tunnel opening at the tell's eastern foot, coded E from the site, no distance. Springs around the site and 'spring ... on the site' are not pools. The western 'deep depression may represent a moat' is not coded (ditch, not a cavity). No reservoir is mentioned in this entry. Entry is Zertal 1992 = English ed. Vol. 1 (2004), read from the packet's OCR excerpt (Internet Archive loan); no plan image in the packet.
